scenario.title: Bus Booking App – Book Bus Ticket
scenario.description:
A registered user searches for buses between two cities for a selected travel date, chooses a bus, selects an available seat, enters passenger details, makes the payment, and verifies the booking confirmation.

Features to test
Feature	What to verify
Login	Valid/invalid credentials
Bus Search	Source, destination, travel date
Bus Selection	Bus details, timing, fare
Seat Selection	Available/occupied seats
Passenger Details	Name, age, gender, contact details
Payment	Successful/failed payment
Booking Confirmation	Ticket, seat, PNR/booking ID

reference_cases.title: Successful bus booking with valid details and payment
reference_cases.preconditions: User is registered with email: testuser@example.com, password: Test@1234
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter email and password
3. Click Login
4. Enter source city, destination city, and travel date
5. Click Search
6. Select a bus from results
7. Click on an available seat
8. Enter passenger name, age, gender, and contact number
9. Proceed to payment
10. Enter card details and complete payment
11. Verify booking confirmation page
reference_cases.test_data: email = testuser@example.com; password = Test@1234; source = Mumbai; destination = Pune; travel_date = 2024-02-15; bus = Volvo AC Sleeper 9:00 AM; seat = 12A; passenger_name = Rajesh Kumar; age = 32; gender = Male; contact = 9876543210; card_number = 4111111111111111; cvv = 123; expiry = 12/25
reference_cases.expected_result: Booking confirmation page displays with PNR number, passenger name (Rajesh Kumar), seat number (12A), bus details (Volvo AC Sleeper 9:00 AM), travel date (2024-02-15), route (Mumbai to Pune), and booking status as Confirmed

reference_cases.title: Login fails with incorrect password
reference_cases.preconditions: User account exists with email: testuser@example.com
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid email and incorrect password
3. Click Login
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.' User remains on login page

reference_cases.title: Search returns no results for invalid route
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter source and destination cities that have no bus service
2. Select travel date
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: Message displayed: 'No buses available for this route on the selected date.' Search results section is empty

reference_cases.title: Cannot select already occupied seat
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has searched for buses. Seat 15B is already booked
reference_cases.steps:
1. Select a bus from search results
2. Attempt to click on seat 15B which shows as occupied/booked
reference_cases.test_data: bus = Scania Multi-Axle 11:30 PM; seat = 15B (status: occupied)
reference_cases.expected_result: Seat 15B is not selectable (grayed out or disabled). No action occurs on click. Tooltip or message shows 'Seat already booked'

reference_cases.title: Search with past date is rejected
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Current date is 2024-02-10
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter source and destination
2. Select a past date from date picker
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message: 'Please select a current or future date.' Search is not executed

reference_cases.title: Passenger age at minimum boundary (1 year)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger details with age = 1
2. Fill other mandatory fields
3. Proceed to payment
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Baby Singh; age = 1; gender = Male; contact = 9123456789
reference_cases.expected_result: Form accepts age value of 1. User proceeds to payment page without errors

reference_cases.title: Passenger age at maximum boundary (120 years)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger details with age = 120
2. Fill other mandatory fields
3. Proceed to payment
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Elder Person; age = 120; gender = Female; contact = 9234567890
reference_cases.expected_result: Form accepts age value of 120. User proceeds to payment page without errors

reference_cases.title: Invalid passenger age rejected (0 or negative)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger details with age = 0
2. Fill other mandatory fields
3. Attempt to proceed
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Test User; age = 0; gender = Male; contact = 9345678901
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error: 'Age must be between 1 and 120.' Cannot proceed to payment

reference_cases.title: Payment fails with insufficient card balance
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected, passenger details entered. Card has balance less than ticket fare
reference_cases.steps:
1. Proceed to payment page
2. Enter card details with insufficient balance
3. Click Pay Now
reference_cases.expected_result: Payment fails. Error message: 'Payment declined due to insufficient funds.' Booking is not confirmed. User remains on payment page

reference_cases.title: Invalid contact number format rejected
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger name, age, gender
2. Enter contact number with less than 10 digits
3. Attempt to proceed to payment
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Amit Sharma; age = 28; gender = Male; contact = 98765
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error: 'Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.' Cannot proceed to payment

reference_cases.title: Search for same day travel (today's date)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Current date and time is 2024-02-10 08:00 AM
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter source and destination
2. Select today's date
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: Search results display buses departing after current time (after 08:00 AM). Buses with departure time before 08:00 AM are not shown

reference_cases.title: Mandatory passenger fields validation
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Leave passenger name field empty
2. Fill age, gender, and contact
3. Attempt to proceed to payment
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error: 'Passenger name is required.' Cannot proceed to payment. Name field is highlighted

helpers.name: setup
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Resets app to initial state: logged out, on Login Page, no visible message, restores all starting data (users, buses, booked seats, cards), clears any bookings created during tests

helpers.name: teardown
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If booking_id is provided and exists, deletes that booking and frees its seat. If booking_id is None, does nothing. Always succeeds silently

helpers.name: current_page
helpers.returns: String: name of current page
helpers.behaviour: Returns the exact page name from the pages list that user is currently on

helpers.name: visible_message
helpers.returns: String: current message shown to user, or empty string if none
helpers.behaviour: Returns the current error, success, or info message displayed on screen. Returns empty string if no message is shown

helpers.name: navigate_to_login
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Navigates to Login Page. Clears any visible message

helpers.name: login
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if login successful, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to log in with provided credentials. If email and password match a user account, logs in and navigates to Search Page, returns true. If credentials invalid, shows message 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.', stays on Login Page, returns false

helpers.name: search_buses
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if search executed, false if validation failed
helpers.behaviour: Validates travel_date is not before current date (2024-02-10). If past date, shows 'Please select a current or future date.', returns false. Otherwise searches for buses matching route and date. If results found, navigates to Search Results Page, returns true. If no buses found, shows 'No buses available for this route on the selected date.', stays on Search Page, returns true (search executed, just no results)

helpers.name: get_search_results
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{bus_id, name, route, departure, arrival, fare}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of buses from last search. If on same-day travel, filters out buses with departure time before current time (08:00). Returns empty list if not on Search Results Page or no search performed

helpers.name: select_bus
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if bus selected, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Selects bus by name from search results. If bus found in results, navigates to Seat Selection Page, returns true. If bus not in results, shows 'Bus not found in search results.', returns false

helpers.name: get_seat_map
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{seat_number, status}, ...] where status is 'available' or 'occupied'
helpers.behaviour: Returns seat map for currently selected bus. Seats already in BOOKED_SEATS for this bus show status 'occupied', others show 'available'. Returns empty list if not on Seat Selection Page

helpers.name: select_seat
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if seat selected, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to select seat. If seat is occupied, shows 'Seat already booked', returns false. If seat is available, selects it, navigates to Passenger Details Page, returns true. If seat doesn't exist on bus, shows 'Invalid seat number.', returns false

helpers.name: enter_passenger_details
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if details accepted, false if validation failed
helpers.behaviour: Validates: passenger_name not empty (shows 'Passenger name is required.'), age between 1 and 120 inclusive (shows 'Age must be between 1 and 120.'), contact is exactly 10 digits (shows 'Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.'). If any validation fails, returns false. If all valid, stores details, navigates to Payment Page, returns true

helpers.name: make_payment
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if payment successful, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Validates card exists in system. Checks if card balance >= ticket fare. If insufficient funds, shows 'Payment declined due to insufficient funds.', returns false. If card not found, shows 'Invalid card details.', returns false. If payment successful, deducts fare from card balance, creates booking with generated PNR (format: PNR + 6 digits), marks seat as booked, navigates to Booking Confirmation Page, returns true

helpers.name: get_booking_confirmation
helpers.returns: Object: {pnr, passenger_name, seat_number, bus_name, travel_date, route, status} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns booking details if on Booking Confirmation Page. Returns None if not on confirmation page or no booking exists

helpers.name: api_login
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, user_email} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Authenticates user. Returns {ok: true, user_email: email} if credentials valid. Returns {ok: false, error: 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.'} if invalid

helpers.name: api_search_buses
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, buses: [...]} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Validates travel_date >= 2024-02-10. If past date, returns {ok: false, error: 'Please select a current or future date.'}. Searches buses matching route. If same-day (2024-02-10), filters buses with departure >= 08:00. Returns {ok: true, buses: [{bus_id, name, route, departure, arrival, fare}, ...]}. Empty buses array if no matches

helpers.name: api_get_seats
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, seats: [...]} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Returns seat map for bus. Returns {ok: true, seats: [{seat_number, status}, ...]} where status is 'available' or 'occupied'. Returns {ok: false, error: 'Bus not found.'} if bus_id invalid

helpers.name: api_book_ticket
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, booking: {...}} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Validates all inputs: passenger_name not empty, age 1-120, contact 10 digits, seat available, card valid and sufficient balance. If any validation fails, returns {ok: false, error: 'specific message'}. If successful, creates booking, deducts fare, returns {ok: true, booking: {pnr, passenger_name, seat_number, bus_name, travel_date, route, status: 'Confirmed', fare}}

helpers.name: db_get_user
helpers.returns: Object: {email, password, name} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns user record if email exists, None otherwise

helpers.name: db_get_bus
helpers.returns: Object: {id, name, route, departure, arrival, fare, total_seats} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns bus record if bus_id exists, None otherwise

helpers.name: db_get_booking
helpers.returns: Object: {pnr, bus_id, seat_number, passenger_name, age, gender, contact, travel_date, fare, status} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns booking record if pnr exists, None otherwise

helpers.name: db_get_booked_seats
helpers.returns: List of strings: ['seat_number', ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of seat numbers currently booked for the bus_id. Returns empty list if no bookings or bus not found

helpers.name: db_get_card_balance
helpers.returns: Float: balance amount or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns current balance for card if card exists, None otherwise

helpers.name: db_delete_booking
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if deleted, false if not found
helpers.behaviour: Deletes booking record and frees the seat. Returns true if booking existed and was deleted, false if pnr not found

rules: Users must log in before searching for buses
Travel date must be current date (2024-02-10) or future date
Same-day searches only show buses departing after current time (08:00)
Each bus has a fixed route, departure time, arrival time, and fare
Passenger name is mandatory and cannot be empty
Passenger age must be between 1 and 120 (inclusive)
Contact number must be exactly 10 digits
Payment requires valid card with balance >= ticket fare
Successful payment generates a PNR (format: PNR followed by 6 digits)
Booking status is 'Confirmed' after successful payment
Each booking reserves exactly one seat on one bus for one travel date
Card balance is deducted by ticket fare upon successful payment

Seat layout visualization - returns seat list with status only
Multiple passengers per booking - one booking per passenger
Booking cancellation or modification - only deletion via teardown
User registration - only predefined test account exists
Password reset or account management features
Booking history or past bookings view
